name: Health Agent Analyze
description: Dispatch free-text vitals (e.g. 'HR=88 BP=145/92 SpO2=94') to health-agent/'s threshold + LLM trend analysis (over its running HTTP server) and return the structured result.
purpose: The Central Orchestrator needs one uniform, typed way to hand vitals to health-agent/'s existing analysis pipeline. health-agent/ owns bare top-level packages (agents/, tools/) that collide with brain/'s own internals if imported into the same process, so this skill reaches it over HTTP instead of importing it (D20).
